metadata.description: Take — the layer between your DAW and the people you make music with.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: One-click Connect: click Connect, approve Take in your browser, and the panel pairs itself — no API key to copy or paste (pasting a token by hand still works as a fallback). Also fixes "No response from server" on macOS/Linux: curl is now resolved by absolute path on every OS, not just Windows, so it launches even when REAPER inherits an empty PATH.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Fix "No response from server": resolve curl by absolute path (unquoted, so cmd.exe can't mangle it) so it launches even when REAPER's environment lacks curl on PATH.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Fix "No response from server": resolve curl by absolute path so it runs even when REAPER's environment lacks it on PATH.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Switches the Reaper server to takeaudio.com and auto-repairs stale saved URLs.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Clarifies the Server URL and API token fields in the Reaper settings panel.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Hotfix: startup temp cleanup, ReaImGui child windows, and render/status handling.
